Shalini, sit, the chai will get cold. You asked how I choose people for my team. Let me tell you about my first hiring panel.
I was new, and the first candidate was from my own college. Same hostel, same professors, even the same canteen jokes. I liked him before he opened his mouth. The next one came from a small polytechnic, spoke slowly, no fancy words. My gut said: the first one.
